records.suppliedStatement: Everything in this section is what the person told us about themselves. We have not checked any of it — not the employer, not the address, not the service area, not the photograph — and we do not repeat it as fact.

credentials.title: NFI Woodburning Specialist
credentials.certNumberNote: not shown by issuer's public lookup
credentials.evidenceNote: Listed on NFI's public Find-an-NFI-Pro search (nficertified.org), searched by location 60089, as Woodburning Specialist under this name and Chimney Monkey. NFI's public lookup displays no certificate number and no expiry, so none is recorded.
credentials.lookupNote: NFI's public tool searches by location and by specialty (wood, gas, pellet, hearth design). It does not take a certificate number, so the strongest check a reader can run there is a name match against the list it returns — search near 60089 and look for this name.
credentials.relevance: NFI certifies knowledge of hearth appliances — the installation and service of wood, gas and pellet equipment. The Woodburning Specialist credential covers wood-burning appliances specifically.

credentials.issuerName: Society of Professional Rope Access Technicians
credentials.title: Level 1 Rope Access Technician
credentials.certNumberNote: supplied by this person — not checked against the roster
credentials.evidenceNote: Number supplied by this person; roster search not yet run. SPRAT's verification system runs as a scripted application that cannot be searched without a browser, so no roster check has been completed for this record.
credentials.expiryNote: no roster search has been run
credentials.lookupNote: SPRAT runs a public certification verification system for technicians, at an application linked from that page. It is the place to check the number this record carries — and we have not checked it yet, so a reader who wants it checked has to run it themselves.
credentials.relevance: Rope access is a way of reaching work on a steep or tall roof safely. It says nothing about chimney knowledge — it is about getting to the flue, not about what happens at it.

notChecked.label: Identity
notChecked.why: We matched a name to an issuer's public roster. We did not check that the person standing in front of you is that person, and we have no way to. The photograph on this record was supplied by the person named and proves nothing.

notChecked.label: Criminal background
notChecked.why: We ran no background check of any kind. Chimney.Services is not a background screener or a consumer reporting agency.

notChecked.label: Work quality
notChecked.why: We inspected no work, called no customer, and read no complaint history. A certification is a test result, not a record of jobs done well.

notChecked.label: Insurance
notChecked.why: We checked no policy. Liability and workers' compensation cover a company, not a person — insurance belongs on a company record, and there is no company record behind this one.
